name: Viking Slash VR
summary:
Viking Slash VR combines Viking brutality with rhythm-based action to create a powerful and energetic VR experience. Armed with your axe, you strike incoming rhythm targets in perfect sync with the music, chaining combos and building momentum as you carve through the battlefield.
